bundle.shortDescription: Agentic-coding operator console for Claude Code.
bundle.longDescription: Promptibrary is a Tauri desktop app that organizes, launches, and observes Claude Code sessions from a library of typed prompt profiles.

updater._DEF6_PUBKEY_REPLACE_BEFORE_RELEASE: Run `tauri signer generate -w ~/.tauri/promptibrary.key` and paste the public key into the `pubkey` field below. See docs/RELEASING.md → 'Generate the keypair (once, per repo)' for the full procedure including base64-encoding the private key into the GitHub Actions secret TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY. The release workflow will fail at `pnpm tauri build` if this is empty.
